title: Detent sheet
description: Reveal more information with a sheet that settles at deliberate heights.
useCase: Reveal more information with a sheet that settles at deliberate heights.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: In-place location sheet with CSS map artwork; not a modal and no geographic data service.
look: Rounded card: a pale sage map with cream roads and a pin, partly covered by a white bottom sheet with grab handle and green button.
motion: Dragging the handle tracks the pointer up to 74 px; releasing beyond 20 px, or tapping, snaps the sheet between two detents with a 280 ms ease-out transform transition.
adapt: The collapsed offset is `74` px, used in the sheet's inline `translateY` and drag clamp; `onPointerUp` snaps past `20` px, easing via `transition: transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)` on `.sheet`. Replace `.map-art` and the location content.
